local self = require('openmw.self')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local player = types.Player.objectIsInstance(self)
local name = player and 'player' or 'npc'
local elapsed, queued, done, reported = 0, false, false, false
local function update(dt)
    elapsed = elapsed + dt
    local speed = types.Actor.stats.attributes.speed(self)
    local blade = types.NPC.stats.skills.longblade(self)
    if done or queued then
        assert(speed.modifier == 2.5 and speed.damage == 1.25)
        assert(blade.modifier == 3.5 and blade.damage == 1.5)
        assert(speed.modified == speed.base + 8.5)
        assert(blade.modified == blade.base + 0.75)
        if not reported then
            print('M15 Lua modifier ' .. (done and 'restored ' or 'committed ') .. name)
            done, reported = true, true
        end
    elseif elapsed >= 2 then
        speed.modifier, speed.damage = 2.5, 1.25
        blade.modifier, blade.damage = 3.5, 1.5
        assert(speed.modified == speed.base + 8.5)
        assert(blade.modified == blade.base + 0.75)
        print('M15 Lua modifier queued ' .. name)
        queued = true
    end
end
return {{engineHandlers={{onUpdate=update,onSave=function() return {{done=done}} end,
    onLoad=function(data) done=data and data.done or false end}}}}

local world = require('openmw.world')
local types = require('openmw.types')
local attached = false
local function update()
    if attached then return end
    for _, actor in pairs(world.activeActors) do
        if types.ESM4NPC.objectIsInstance(actor) then
            if not actor:hasScript('scripts/m15_resource_current.lua') then
                actor:addScript('scripts/m15_resource_current.lua')
            end
            attached = true
            print('M15 Lua NPC attached')
            return
        end
    end
end
return {{engineHandlers = {{onUpdate=update}}}}
